description: This file defines classes and behaviors for managing namespaces in Kivy applications, specifically through KNSpace and KNSpaceBehavior, enabling objects to be named, accessed, and organized within hierarchical or forked namespaces.

classes.name: KNSpace
classes.description: A namespace container class that stores named Kivy objects as ObjectProperties, supports parent-child hierarchy, and allows for forking to create isolated or shared namespaces.

classes.name: KNSpaceBehavior
classes.description: A mixin class that enables objects to be named and associated with a namespace, supporting dynamic namespace assignment, inheritance, and forking.

methods.name: KNSpace.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a KNSpace instance with optional parent namespace and reference retention setting.

methods.name: KNSpace.__setattr__
methods.description: Overrides attribute setting to dynamically create ObjectProperties for new names or update existing ones.

methods.name: KNSpace.__getattribute__
methods.description: Retrieves attribute values, searching parent namespaces if necessary.

methods.name: KNSpace.property
methods.description: Returns or creates an ObjectProperty for a given name, enabling dynamic property management.

methods.name: KNSpace.fork
methods.description: Creates a new KNSpace instance with the current namespace as its parent, allowing for isolated or shared object access.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the behavior with an optional namespace.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior._get_knspace
methods.description: Retrieves the associated namespace, searching parent hierarchy if needed.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior._set_knspace
methods.description: Sets the namespace, supporting special 'fork' value to create a forked namespace.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior.knspace
methods.description: AliasProperty linking getter and setter for the namespace.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior.knspace_key
methods.description: Property defining the attribute name used to search for parent namespace.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior._get_knsname
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the object.

methods.name: KNSpaceBehavior._set_knsname
methods.description: Sets the name of the object and updates the namespace accordingly.
